# ssh -L 5432:localhost:5432 -C -N -l  tewilkins 172.26.150.60
# Download required databases (mwbugs and mwstr) to local directory (local_dir):
if (!dir.exists("gpkg")) dir.create("gpkg") # Safely creates a new folder if it doesn't already exist
urls <- c("https://tools.thewerg.unimelb.edu.au/mwbugs/data/mwbugs_db_v2.1.1.gpkg", # 50.7MB
          "https://tools.thewerg.unimelb.edu.au/mwstr/data/mwstr_v1.3.1.gpkg")      # 780.0MB
options(timeout = 900) # Increases time to download files through R - default timeout is 60 seconds.
for (url in urls){
  if (!file.exists(paste0("gpkg/", basename(url)))){
    print(paste("Downloading", basename(url)))
    download.file(
      url, 
      destfile = paste0("gpkg/", basename(url)), # file path where the downloaded file is to be saved.
      mode = "wb") # Code written to download binary files must use mode = "wb" (or "ab")
  }
}


# Connect to MW databases:
mwstr <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), dbname = "gpkg/mwstr_v1.3.1.gpkg")

# mwstr <- DBI::dbConnect(RPostgres::Postgres(),dbname = "mwstr",
#                           host = "localhost", user = "readonly", password = "reachcode_42")

streams <- sf::st_read(mwstr, query = "SELECT * FROM streams;")
coast <- sf::st_read(mwstr, query = "SELECT * FROM coast;")

model_data <- rio::import_list("~/uomShare/wergStaff/tewilkins/git-data/env_optimisation/data/biota_sampprs_for_optimisation.xlsx")
# list2env(model_data, globalenv())
sampprs <- model_data$sampprs

stream_data_wgs84 <- sf::st_transform(streams$geom, crs = 4326)
coast_data_wgs84 <- sf::st_transform(coast$geom, crs = 4326)
stream_coord <- st_coordinates(stream_data_wgs84)
site_points <- data.frame(X = sampprs$coord_X,
                          Y = sampprs$coord_Y,
                          dupe = as.integer(duplicated(sampprs$coord_X)))

streams$sampleable[streams$sampleable == 0] <- "Non-sampleable"
streams$sampleable[streams$sampleable == 1] <- "Sampleable"

# streams$sampleable <- factor(streams$sampleable, levels = c("Non-sampleable", "Sampleable"))

# Sort streams dataframe by sampleable status (non-sampleable first):
#streams <- streams[order(streams$sampleable),]

# Reorder stream_data_wgs84 to match sorted order in streams:
#stream_data_wgs84 <- stream_data_wgs84[match(streams$geom, stream_data_wgs84$geom),]

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = stream_data_wgs84, aes(color = streams$sampleable), fill = NA) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("powderblue","grey50"), name = "Stream network\nmapping region") + 
  geom_sf(data = coast_data_wgs84, fill = NA) +
  #geom_point(data = site_points, aes(x = X, y = Y), pch = 19, size = 1) +
  annotation_scale(location = "bl", width_hint = 0.5) +
  annotation_north_arrow(location = "bl", which_north = "true", pad_x = unit(0.75, "in"), 
                         pad_y = unit(0.25, "in"), 
                         style = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(min(stream_coord[,1]) - diff(range(stream_coord[,1])) * 0.1, 
                    max(stream_coord[,1]) + diff(range(stream_coord[,1])) * 0.01), 
           ylim = c(min(stream_coord[,2]) - diff(range(stream_coord[,1])) * 0.1, 
                    max(stream_coord[,2]) + diff(range(stream_coord[,1])) * 0.01), 
           expand = FALSE) +
   xlab("Longitude") + ylab("Latitude") + 
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, size=1))



DBI::dbDisconnect(mwstr)
